candidate_identity: Exact source SHA-256, Git HEAD and source status recorded in each report
hosted_parameters: The separate frozen benchmarks/comprehensive-runtime-plan.json specifies the hosted 4 latency / 2 allocation / 4 artifact pairs; the counts below are this development CLI's defaults.

ranking.fixture: 64 deterministic normalized float32 patterns; exact fixture/query hashes recorded
ranking.database: In-memory SQLite, all fixture pages in scope, schema and row order unchanged between arms
ranking.allocation_metric: tracemalloc-tracked peak allocations (including NumPy registered buffers); not total RSS or untracked SQLite/native allocations
ranking.validation: Untimed exact dictionary/list/float equality against the frozen baseline before trials and after every timed call; a separate untimed cursor audit forbids fetchall and enforces fetchmany <= 4096 with explicit cursor closure
ranking.ordering: Alternating baseline/candidate and candidate/baseline, equal first-position counts

artifact_initialization.artifacts: Deterministic local synthetic bytes, SHA-256 pinned in the report; never downloaded
artifact_initialization.runtimes: Mock ONNX and tokenizer runtimes; excludes actual model loading, parsing and inference
artifact_initialization.cache_state: Warm filesystem cache after validation and warmups
artifact_initialization.validation: Exact identity, fingerprint and runtime-consumed bytes; separate untimed read/hash byte instrumentation

reporting.retain: Every observation, order position, fixture hash, source hash, environment and arguments; optional --events writes an exclusively created JSONL ledger with flush/fsync after each observation and a failure marker, outside timers
reporting.summary: Per-arm medians, every paired candidate/baseline ratio and their median; wall time and process CPU reported separately
reporting.process_cpu: Secondary diagnostic for scheduler interference; never substituted for user-visible wall latency
reporting.timing_separation: No tracing, equality validation, result hashing or garbage collection inside latency timers
reporting.interpretation: Development component evidence only; no formal guarantee, semantic-quality claim or end-to-end speedup
reporting.historical_experiments: Does not reuse or retune any previous formal recall workload
